notes.subject: קראתי ... בכל לב
notes.rationale: taziwert n lɛahd: segmi taqbaylit tessutsay s yiwet n talɣa i 's wul ameẓẓul', sin n yismawen n taɛbranit (בכל, לב) ttwasmezglen ɣef snat n tseddarin s yiwet n tsiwelt

notes.subject: אצרה
notes.rationale: yettwaḥrez deg wawal n yelyeḥ d yebɛed — tasiwelt tettini-d ɣef tdukli: yella wid i d-yennan 'ad ḥeddeɣ' (ttwaɛqed) syin wid i d-yennan 'ad ṣeḥḥeɣ' (ttwaḥrez); yerna yella ukayad: d aneggaru n lɛahd mačči d tafelsit

translation: Ceɣliɣ s wul ameẓẓul; d-yisir-i Yahwe; lɛahd-im ad ḥeddeɣ.
